name: Multi-path / split-flow
required_evidence: Pool/account state и shared resource replay
financing_condition: В одном atomic domain при доказанном repayment
scaling_constraints: Capacity after costs; shared liquidity, fixed costs, CU/message bounds

name: Stable/correlated assets
financing_condition: Условно: только немедленные операции в одном domain
scaling_constraints: Small spread, depeg, stale oracle; correlation ≠ identity

name: DEX ↔ mint/redeem/wrapper
required_evidence: Exchange rates, права, caps, fees, queues
financing_condition: Immediate conversion — возможно; async queue — нет
scaling_constraints: Eligibility, pause, cutoff, rights transfer, latency/capital lock

name: Liquidation + collateral sale
financing_condition: Условно, если protocol и atomic repayment доказаны
scaling_constraints: Close factor, bonus, competition, shared collateral and pool liquidity

name: PT/YT и composite products
required_evidence: Vector claims, SY rates, maturity and pool state
financing_condition: Только для конкретного проверенного atomic recipe
scaling_constraints: Maturity, negative yield, fees, vector conservation

name: Intent / batch solver
required_evidence: Intent rules, auction snapshot, exact external routes
financing_condition: Один из вариантов financing, не доступ к order flow
scaling_constraints: Access, limit prices, deadlines, partial fills, inventory and surplus ownership

name: Cross-chain / CEX–DEX / spot–perp basis
required_evidence: Domain-separated depth, funding, borrow, finality/withdrawal terms
financing_condition: Обычный atomic flashloan не финансирует междоменное ожидание
scaling_constraints: Inventory, bridge/CEX settlement, margin, funding and hedge risk
